metadata.name: Rick Rule投资专业术语库
metadata.source: Rick Rule 50年投资经验术语精粹

portfolio_protection.definition: 投资组合保护，通过多元化资产配置抵御市场风险
portfolio_protection.rick_rule_usage: 在通胀环境下通过资源类资产提供的财富保护
portfolio_protection.example: Strategic metals and energy assets provide essential portfolio protection during inflationary periods

contrarian_investing.definition: 逆向投资，在市场普遍悲观时买入，乐观时卖出
contrarian_investing.rick_rule_usage: 在资产被市场憎恨时识别价值投资机会
contrarian_investing.example: The key is to invest when assets are unloved and unfashionable, not when they're popular

cyclical_positioning.definition: 基于经济和市场周期的战略性资产定位
cyclical_positioning.rick_rule_usage: 根据50年周期观察进行的投资定位
cyclical_positioning.example: Understanding where we are in the cycle is absolutely crucial for successful positioning

systematic_risk.definition: 系统性风险，影响整个市场或经济的不可分散风险
systematic_risk.rick_rule_usage: 当前货币政策创造的系统性通胀风险
systematic_risk.example: Current monetary policy creates significant systematic risk across traditional asset classes

duration_risk.definition: 久期风险，利率变化对债券和利率敏感资产价格的影响
duration_risk.rick_rule_usage: 当前环境下长期债券面临的重大风险
duration_risk.example: Investors should be particularly cautious of duration risk in the current environment

concentration_risk.definition: 集中度风险，投资过度集中于特定资产、行业或地区的风险
concentration_risk.rick_rule_usage: 平衡专业化投资与适度分散的重要性
concentration_risk.example: Diversification is important, but over-diversification can dilute returns

underlying_fundamentals.definition: 基本面因素，影响资产内在价值的基础经济因素
underlying_fundamentals.rick_rule_usage: 资源行业强劲基本面与市场情绪的脱节
underlying_fundamentals.example: Resource sectors remain unloved despite fundamentally strong underlying conditions

supply_constraints.definition: 供应约束，由于投资不足或其他因素导致的供应限制
supply_constraints.rick_rule_usage: 数十年基础设施投资不足造成的资源供应约束
supply_constraints.example: Decades of underinvestment in resource development will likely create supply constraints

relative_value.definition: 相对价值，资产相对于其他资产或历史水平的估值比较
relative_value.rick_rule_usage: 资源类资产相对于传统资产的价值洼地
relative_value.example: Resource assets offer compelling relative value compared to traditional equity markets

patient_capital.definition: 耐心资本，能够等待长期回报的投资资金
patient_capital.rick_rule_usage: 成功资源投资需要的耐心和长期视角
patient_capital.example: This creates exceptional opportunities for patient investors who understand the cycle

quality_management.definition: 优质管理团队，具备专业能力和诚信品格的公司管理层
quality_management.rick_rule_usage: 选择投资标的时对管理层质量的重视
quality_management.example: I recommend building positions in quality resource companies with strong management teams

gradual_accumulation.definition: 渐进式建仓，通过时间分散逐步建立投资仓位
gradual_accumulation.rick_rule_usage: 降低市场时机风险的实用投资方法
gradual_accumulation.example: I recommend building positions gradually rather than trying to time the market perfectly

real_interest_rates.definition: 实际利率，名义利率减去通胀率后的利率水平
real_interest_rates.rick_rule_usage: 负实际利率环境下的资产选择策略
real_interest_rates.example: When real interest rates are negative, traditional safe havens become wealth destroyers

inflationary_periods.definition: 通胀期，物价水平持续上升的经济时期
inflationary_periods.rick_rule_usage: 通胀环境下需要的根本性投资策略调整
inflationary_periods.example: Inflationary periods require fundamental shifts in portfolio allocation

purchasing_power.definition: 购买力，货币能够购买商品和服务的能力
purchasing_power.rick_rule_usage: 通胀环境下财富保值的核心关注点
purchasing_power.example: Traditional portfolios failed to preserve purchasing power during the 1970s

natural_resources.definition: 自然资源，包括能源、金属、农产品等基础商品
natural_resources.rick_rule_usage: 通胀环境下的核心投资主题
natural_resources.example: Natural resource investments become increasingly critical during inflationary periods

strategic_metals.definition: 战略金属，对国防和工业具有重要意义的关键金属
strategic_metals.rick_rule_usage: 投资组合保护和长期价值储存
strategic_metals.example: Strategic metals provide essential portfolio protection when traditional assets fail

resource_scarcity.definition: 资源稀缺，自然资源供应相对于需求的不足
resource_scarcity.rick_rule_usage: 未来投资机会的根本驱动力
resource_scarcity.example: Resource scarcity will become increasingly apparent in the coming years

术语选择原则: 根据报告主题选择相关术语
确保术语使用的准确性和专业性

专业水平标识.基础概念: 所有投资者都应理解的核心术语
专业水平标识.中级概念: 需要一定投资经验才能充分理解
专业水平标识.高级概念: 需要深度投资知识和经验
